scripts.build: npm run assets && JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.dev: npm run assets && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --livereload
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.js && bundle exec ruby tests/others-previews.rb && bundle exec ruby tests/content.rb && bundle exec htmlproofer _site --disable-external
